2995371.baseName: Argos Home Inflatable Santa Christmas Decoration
2995371.variantName: Argos Home Inflatable Santa Christmas Decoration
2995371.sourceDescription: Picture a giant inflatable Santa standing in your garden, lit up and ready to greet visitors as they arrive. This one comes pre-lit with 6 LED bulbs included, so you're not left hunting for extras. Plug it into the mains and it inflates and lights up in one go. You can use it indoors or outdoors depending on where you want the festive impact. The timer feature means it'll switch itself on and off automatically without you needing to remember. It arrives fully assembled, which cuts out the usual Christmas decoration setup stress. The 5m lead between the plug and the decoration gives you flexibility with placement. Fabric construction keeps it manageable, while mains power keeps it running reliably. You're looking at a decoration that does the work for you once it's plugged in, bringing a bit of seasonal magic to your doorstep without the faff. . Size H180, W90, D60cm.; Suitable for indoor and outdoor use.; Pre-lit.; Timer feature.; Requires 6 x LED bulbs (included).; Mains powered.; 5m lead length between plug and decoration.; Fully assembled.; Not suitable for those under 16 years.; Made from fabric.; Manufacturer's 1 year guarantee.

3bzkm5ct.baseName: Walplus 150 LED Lights Pre-lit Artificial Christmas Tree - Black - 180 cm
3bzkm5ct.variantName: Walplus 150 LED Lights Pre-lit Artificial Christmas Tree - Black - 180 cm
3bzkm5ct.sourceDescription: This black artificial Christmas tree forms the striking centrepiece of your Christmas decorations, creating a unique Christmas atmosphere! This Christmas tree, made of PVC material, is very lifelike in its shape and appearance. The steel feet add to its stability. The Christmas tree can be used again every year, making it a very economical choice compared to a real tree. Featuring energy-efficient LED lights, it lights up beautifully and creates a cosy holiday atmosphere. What's more, decorated with the beautiful peak and balls, this Xmas tree will be eye-catching in your home. Note: The product has a USB connector, but the certified 5V USB power source is not included. Product Specifications Tree colour: Black Shiny rose gold, matt rose gold and glitter rose gold Material: PVC, steel, plastic Total height: 180 cm Tree diameter: 93 cm LED string light length: 15 m Voltage: DC 5 V Power: 5 W With 564 tips With 150 LEDs With USB connection Assembly required: Yes Delivery contains: 1 x Christmas tree 1 x Stand 1 x LED string light 1 x Peak 20 x 3 cm ball 21 x 4 cm ball 20 x 6 cm ball This product is powered by DC 5V, but the certified 5V USB power source is not included. Higher voltage may cause overheating to occur and may result in damage to the device and the potential risk of overheating and fire. GPSR • By choosing FSC certified products, you are supporting responsible management of the world's forests. This artificial tree is intended exclusively for indoor festive decoration. Assemble the product on a flat, stable surface using the provided stand to prevent tipping, which could cause injury or property damage. Keep this item away from open flames, candles, fireplaces, and space heaters, as synthetic materials can melt or catch fire under extreme heat. If using electric lights, ensure they are safety-certified and do not leave them turned on unattended. This product is not a toy; keep small parts, detachable ornaments, and packaging away from young children and pets to prevent choking or suffocation. Store in a cool, dry place when not in use to ensure long-term structural safety. WALPLUS, Unit 124, Anglesey Business Park, Littleworth Road, Hednesford, WS12 1NR, United Kingd

5eb79098.baseName: Harbour Housewares Classic Real Christmas Tree Stand - Black
5eb79098.variantName: Harbour Housewares Classic Real Christmas Tree Stand - Black
5eb79098.sourceDescription: You need to hold up your Christmas tree somehow, but why should you spend a fortune on a stand that you just plan to cover up with your favourite skirt? With the Harbour Housewares Traditional Christmas Tree Stand, Metal Frame and Plastic Holder, you can keep your tree as secure as can be and save money! This economical, yet durable Christmas tree stand can be used again and again through many holiday seasons. - Heavy-duty metal base with a sturdy plastic holder on top - Secure a tree with a trunk up to 16cm (6.3") in diameter just by twisting the four bolts featured in the design - Water container is included in the design to keep living trees fresh and green Caution: place on a stable, level surface and ensure the tree is securely fastened before use. Check regularly for stability. Rinkit SAS, 6 Rue de la Mare Blanche, France, sales@rinkit.com
